topic_title: Dangers of Night Driving & Overdriving Headlights
prompt: Why is the twilight period between dusk and full darkness one of the most dangerous driving times?

options.text: Highway electronic speed limit display signs temporarily turn off for recalibration
Automotive engine oil viscosity thickens rapidly during twilight temperature shifts
Fading daylight diminishes road contrast before artificial headlights become effective
Atmospheric barometric pressure drops cause sudden vehicle brake pedal vibrations
